message: Expression-bodied lambdas whose expression is of type 'dynamic' are not supported. Cast the expression to a non-dynamic type, for example 'object' or 'IExpression'. Alternatively, use a local function, or, for a void expression, a lambda with a block body.
title: Expression-bodied lambdas whose expression is of type 'dynamic' are not supported.
rationale: The report site in TemplateAnnotator.VisitAnonymousFunctionExpression only checks the expression body of a lambda, so 'anonymous functions' (which always have a block body) and lambdas with a block body are never concerned; the message also omits the simplest fix, a cast to any non-dynamic type, and suggests 'IExpression' as if it were the only possible type.
